title: coherent reduction skeleton existence
statement: For the actual finite quotient coefficient systems, a flat-term K-flat construction gives a nonempty coherent reduction skeleton with the representative, normalized tower, completion projection and all model equations. It uses [lem-pc-kflat-resolution] and [lem-pur-kflat-change-of-rings].

source.place: Integral operations and normalized coefficient reduction model.

proof.text: Construct the balanced ordinary finite associations by adjunction uniqueness. Apply the strict representative theorem to obtain the simultaneous strict model, the normalized system and the exact finite evaluation equation.

Apply the representative Roos comparison to the strict model. The normalized uniqueness clause of integralScalarExtensionWellDefined descends this good-complex comparison to the global completion isomorphism. Its compatibility equation identifies the inverse completion component with the fixed scalar-extension comparison followed by the inverse local Roos comparison; compose its projection equation to get the required completion projection.

proof_origin.place: Integral operations: balanced tensor association, strict quotient normalization, and projection-normalized Roos descent.
